page.layout: One printed page: a woodcut frieze at the head; then a title block of centred lines (dedication to Jacobus Augustus Thuanus); below it a large woodcut initial with the opening text in running lines. No margin notes. Digitiser watermark at lower right is not transcribed.
page.notes: The large woodcut initial "I" is joined to "LLUSTRISSIME" in the transcription as printed ("ILLUSTRISSIME"). A dagger mark (†) stands below the line "propensio, &" between "Tua" and the preceding words; it is a printed signature/reference mark and is not transcribed as text. The title block is set in mixed roman, italic and spaced capitals; spacing has been normalised. Small specks on the page are not transcribed.
